_help: Crisis and emergency contacts. Entries are only shown on the website when "verified" is true. Call each number yourself before setting verified to true, and re-check at least every six months. Never publish a number you have not confirmed.
intro: Bloom is a bereavement support service. It is not an emergency or crisis service and cannot respond to someone in immediate danger.
emergencyNote: If you or someone near you is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services right now.
